line: Cook a little extra and share it with a neighbor.
paragraph: A man from the mountain paths of Hubei Province has made over two hundred trips to remote villages. He carries phones and patience to elderly parents whose children live among the 110 million Chinese working abroad. They gather around small screens to see faces they have missed for months or years. He does not hurry the meetings. He waits while mothers wipe their eyes and fathers lean closer to hear every word. Someone cooks a little extra for him before he walks back down the path.

seed.summary: It’s estimated that over 110 million Chinese live and work abroad, which for the family members they leave behind can be heart-wrenching and difficult, above all for the elderly. But thanks to a generous soul born to the mountain paths of Hubei Province, these severed family ties are being reconnected through social media and delivery
seed.sourceTitle: Man Makes 200+ Trips to Remote Villages to Connect Elders with Their Children Working Abroad
